2607.24884.title: Beyond "What to Retrieve": Uncertainty in Retrieval-Augmented Code Generation
2607.24884.paper_summary: Repository-level code generation relies on heterogeneous evidence whose relevance, compatibility, and completeness are inherently uncertain. Similar-code examples, repository context, and project-specific APIs may provide complementary information, but can also introduce noisy, redundant, or conflicting signals. Existing retrieval-augmented approaches primarily optimize retrieval relevance without explicitly modeling how uncertainty in retrieved evidence affects downstream generation. We introduce OpenCoder, an uncertainty-aware framework that estimates source-specific uncertainty, uses it to filter and rank heterogeneous evidence, and guides generation, verification, and repair. A factorial analysis over API knowledge, repository context, and similar-code evidence reveals no universal additive source ranking; instead, significant cross-source interactions depend on the accompanying evidence and LLM backend. On an expanded 32-task RepoExec-inline evaluation, OpenCoder improves GPT selected-output correctness over Baseline RAG from 56.25\% to 78.13\%. However, it matches a verification-and-repair control, and the corresponding Gemini improvement is not statistically supported, indicating backend-dependent benefits. Target-aware API refinement also substantially improves API-set retrieval. These findings support treating uncertainty as an actionable control signal for repository-level retrieval, verification, and repair.
2607.24884.paper_summary_zh: 儲存庫級別的代碼生成依賴於異質證據，其相關性、兼容性和完整性本質上是不確定的。相似代碼示例、儲存庫上下文和專案特定的 API 可能提供補充信息，但也可能引入噪聲、冗餘或衝突的信號。現有的檢索增強方法主要優化檢索的相關性，而未明確建模檢索證據中的不確定性如何影響下游生成。我們引入了 OpenCoder，一個意識到不確定性的框架，該框架估計源特定的不確定性，利用它過濾和排名異質證據，並指導生成、驗證和修復。對 API 知識、儲存庫上下文和相似代碼證據的因子分析顯示沒有普遍的加法源排名；相反，顯著的跨源互動取決於伴隨的證據和 LLM 後端。在擴展的 32 任務 RepoExec-inline 評估中，OpenCoder 將 GPT 選擇輸出的正確性從基線 RAG 的 56.25\% 提高到 78.13\%。然而，它與驗證和修復控制相匹配，對應的 Gemini 改進在統計上並不支持，表明後端依賴性利益。目標感知的 API 精煉也顯著改善了 API 集的檢索。這些發現支持將不確定性視為儲存庫級別檢索、驗證和修復的可操作控制信號。
